items.quote: I‘m looking for a Freelance Videographer in Dubai (must be based in Dubai).
items.statement: The author is looking for a Freelance Videographer in Dubai.

items.quote: I will be happy to support your growth and place you with my clients in real estate if, of course, we have great results working together.
items.statement: The author offers support for the growth of the videographer and potential placements with clients if results are positive.

items.quote: The ideal candidate has the following qualifications: - Experience in filming content for course creators - Understand the specifications of YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.
items.statement: The ideal candidate should have experience in filming content for course creators and understand specifications of various social media platforms.

items.quote: - Fluent in English, and able to create and proof captions on videos.
items.statement: The ideal candidate should be fluent in English and able to create captions for videos.

items.quote: The ideal candidate has the following abilities: - Professional editing capabilities - Creative ideal for editing short/long videos on real estate topics.
items.statement: The ideal candidate should have professional editing capabilities and creativity for video editing.

items.quote: To apply, fill out the form and I will contact you over email, so make sure you use an email that you check regularly.
items.statement: Applicants should fill out a form and ensure they use a regularly checked email for communication.

items.quote: Applications through Direct Messaging will not be considered.
items.statement: Applications through Direct Messaging will not be considered.

overview: This source is a job listing for a freelance videographer in Dubai, detailing qualifications and application instructions.
